expected_basis: Native net.inet.tcp.sack.enable is independently set and read before and after every run
limitations: One operator-owned FreeBSD VM; three repeats per family and SACK state; no population independence or statistical acceptance claim
Clean directly attached private IPv4 and temporary ULA IPv6; no impairment, routed IPv6, proxy, NAT or held-out coverage
SACK control affects the dedicated guest TCP stack and is restored on stop, signal or deadline
Guest firewall and existing default routes are recorded without modification; temporary IPv6 adds only a connected prefix
macOS kernel RSTs remain enabled; IPv6 scanner uses kernel connect; source child CPU/RSS is not guest CPU/RSS
Missing, failed, dropped and unresolved outcomes remain in all-planned denominators; families/states are not pooled
